messages.content: Hi, my company wants 60 one-kg kaju katli gift boxes delivered to our office in Ludhiana next Friday.

The per‑kg price for Kaju katli is Rs 1,100 and a 1 kg gift box adds Rs 80 for packing, so each box is about Rs 1,180. For 60 boxes the rough estimate is 60 × 1,180 = Rs 70,800 (prices can change during festivals and the team will confirm the final amount).  

May I have your full name and WhatsApp number, and could you share the exact delivery address of your office?
My name is Neha Arora, company Arora Textiles, WhatsApp +91 98765 43210. Please deliver to the Arora Textiles office in Ludhiana; your team can take the exact address on WhatsApp.
Could you let me know the preferred delivery time on Friday 16 October 2026 (e.g., morning, afternoon, or a specific hour)?
No specific time, any time on Friday is fine.
Shall I send this to the Mehra Sweets team?
The Mehra Sweets team will contact you on WhatsApp within the next two hours to confirm the order details and final price.
Thank you. Our team will be in touch shortly.
